PCK, Psykoterapeutisk klinik is a psychiatric facility located in [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]]. It is notable in the context of the 2024 ADHD database report for its unique performance regarding [[indikator-9|Indikator 9]], a newly introduced quality indicator measuring psychotherapy for adults with ADHD. During a shortened initial reporting period from April 1 to July 31, 2025, the nationwide fulfillment rate for this indicator was extremely low at just 1%. However, PCK, Psykoterapeutisk klinik stood out as the only department in Denmark with a measured fulfillment rate of 9% (among departments with at least three patients in the denominator), contrasting sharply with the 0% fulfillment seen in most other departments [^src1]. 

In addition to its performance on psychotherapy metrics, the facility is also tracked for [[indikator-11|Indikator 11]], which evaluates pharmacological treatment for adults with ADHD. For this indicator, the clinic recorded 28 fulfilled events out of a denominator of 135, resulting in a fulfillment rate of 21% (with a confidence interval of 14-29%) [^src2]. These metrics highlight the clinic's active role in the broader national effort to systematically measure and improve the quality of ADHD treatment for adults in Denmark.
